redaction_rules.paths: Machine-specific /root, /workspace, /Users/<name>, /home/<name> and /tmp/ray prefixes replaced; remaining hierarchy retained

original_hash_scope: Original hashes refer to retained private files. Published files may be redacted and/or gzip encoded; verify.py validates public bytes, not possession of originals. Redacted plans/requests cannot reproduce original plan/source-envelope hashes.
